integrity: Analytic proof and finite independent numerical diagnostics; no external expert verification or independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for two known-centered Gaussian point sources of known common width, three ideal symmetric point measurements, fixed equal independent normal measurement variance, and unknown linear flux/background coefficients. No unrestricted-design, finite-pixel, Poisson, astrometric-uncertainty, or field-validation claim. Tied-optimum separation exists analytically but is not proved unique; numerical approximations are illustrations.
title: Singular and doubly optimal three-point designs for two Gaussian image sources
